recentItems.title: Happy Vijayadashami 2026 🏹✨ | May Goodness Always Triumph Over Evil | Dussehra Wishes
recentItems.description:

May this auspicious Vijayadashami bring new hope, happiness, prosperity and positivity into your life. May goodness always triumph over evil, and may every new beginning lead you towards success and peace.

Let us celebrate the timeless message of Vijayadashami — the victory of truth, courage and righteousness over evil. May this festive occasion fill your heart with joy and your home with blessings! ❤️✨
